tool_calls.name: /bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import os, tempfile; p=Path(\"docs/SUBOPTIMAL_TOOLS.md\"); p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True); existing=p.read_text() if p.exists() else \"# Suboptimal Tool Behavior\\n\"; entry=\"\\n## semantic_replace_body: main.go\\n\\n- Observed: The first replacement used "'`rand.Int()` and semantic diagnostics reported that the resolved `crypto/rand.Int` requires an `io.Reader` and `*big.Int`.'"\\n- Workaround: Replaced the body with "'`rand.Int(rand.Reader, big.NewInt(1000000000))` and checked the tool diagnostics again.'"\\n- Root cause: Import resolution selected "'`crypto/rand`; its `Int` API differs from the zero-argument math/rand function.'"\\n\"; data=(existing.rstrip()+\"\\n\"+entry).encode(); fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=\".SUBOPTIMAL_TOOLS.\", dir=str(p.parent)); f=os.fdopen(fd,\"wb\"); f.write(data); f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno()); f.close(); os.replace(tmp,p); d=os.open(p.parent,os.O_RDONLY); os.fsync(d); os.close(d)'"
